verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions custom fields or configurable workflow statuses. It covers only adjacent features: personalized dashboards, templates, Kanban and table views, and no-code automations, none of which shows that a product manager can define fields or statuses. The axis clearly applies to a work-management product, so absence of evidence yields none.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can customize fields and workflow statuses to match my team's process
